title: Using Resources
seo_title: Year 11 Science: Using Resources Worksheets (GCSE Combined Science)
standard_text: Using the Earth's resources and sustainable development; potable water; waste water treatment; alternative methods of extracting metals (higher tier); life cycle assessment; ways of reducing the use of resources, including reuse and recycling.
meta_desc: Free Year 11 GCSE Combined Science worksheets on using resources: finite and renewable resources, potable water, desalination, waste water treatment, life cycle assessment and recycling. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Potable water is safe to drink, not pure.
key_sub: Reduce, reuse, recycle saves energy and resources.
body_html:
How to think about it

Chemists help us use Earth's resources sustainably.

  • Potable water: filter to remove solids, then sterilise with chlorine, ozone or UV. Desalination removes salt from sea water.
  • Waste water: screening, sedimentation, then sludge is digested anaerobically and effluent is treated aerobically.
  • A life cycle assessment looks at raw materials, manufacture, use and disposal.
Example

Recycling saves 95% of 200 MJ. Energy saved?

0.95 × 200

Answer: 190 MJ

Example

What kills microbes in water?

Sterilising

Answer: chlorine, ozone or UV

Common mistakes

  • Thinking potable water is pure.
  • Thinking filtering kills microbes.
  • Thinking a life cycle assessment only looks at disposal.

faq.a: Fresh water from rivers, reservoirs or ground water is filtered to remove solids and sterilised with chlorine, ozone or ultraviolet light.

faq.q: What are the stages of a life cycle assessment?
faq.a: Extracting and processing raw materials, manufacturing and packaging, use during its lifetime, and disposal.
